mentions.claim_text: He notes Poland has launched a domestic production line of long range strike drones as a government backed effort, having just spoken about strikes inside Russia.
mentions.quote: Poland has launched a new production line of domestically developed longrange strike drone
mentions.falsify_match: Polish long range drones are used against Russian territory.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a weapon of mass destruction that he asked about and was told is like nuclear but is not nuclear, never seen before, which vaporised everything as it went up while leaving houses and cars untouched.
mentions.quote: it's like nuclear, but it is not nuclear
mentions.falsify_match: A weapon with those effects is used.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such weapon. The described effect, killing without damaging structures, matches the popular description of a neutron bomb.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them Poland will provoke and stick the bear and the bear will retaliate in the days ahead, and that he waited and waited before saying it.
mentions.quote: Poland will provoke and stick the bear
mentions.falsify_match: Russia strikes Poland after a Polish provocation.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a plan to divide it pro-Russia and pro-Ukraine, an escalation, and then World War III above Europe with all of NATO jumping in when Poland was struck, followed by America sending forces.
mentions.quote: when they struck Poland were all of them jumped in
mentions.falsify_match: NATO article five is invoked over a strike on Poland.

mentions.claim_text: He says there will be an acceleration of wars and rumours of wars, and recalls telling a named minister's son what was coming when asked.
mentions.quote: You'll hear this wars and rumors of wars acceleration
mentions.falsify_match: A period of rapidly compounding conflicts.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing here can fail; any news flow satisfies it.

mentions.claim_text: He says people are always curious and he only tells what the Lord shows him, then repeats watch Poland and that he saw war and an acceleration of World War III above it.
mentions.quote: Poland, watch Poland. Watch all these different areas
mentions.falsify_match: A major escalation centred on Poland.

mentions.claim_text: He calls the Clarity Act and the Save America Act passed in prayer, and asks for the wave of financial outpouring to follow.
mentions.quote: we call forth the Clarity Act and the Save America Act passed
mentions.falsify_match: Both acts pass.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls that the last time he had said the president would go to Turkey and that the Lord said there would be ungodly alliances, with covenants with Turkey and Syria to pray against.
mentions.quote: There'll be ungodly alliances to pray against ungodly covenants with Turkey
mentions.falsify_match: A formal American agreement with Turkey and Syria that later goes badly.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such agreement, or one that holds well.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw earthquake warnings on the Mississippi River at around 4.2, 3.2 and a 2 point something, given as a warning, and then a very massive hurricane hitting by Mar-a-Lago in the Miami area.
mentions.quote: on the Mississippi River, I saw earthquake warnings
mentions.falsify_match: Magnitude 4 range New Madrid quakes followed by a major south Florida hurricane.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs. Small New Madrid quakes are recorded routinely.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw an antichrist spirit trying to influence the president's mind as he goes over there, which the Lord called a demonic spirit trying to mess with him, and people who would be influencing this.
mentions.quote: an antichrist spirit trying to influence President Trump's mind
mentions.falsify_match: The president makes a decision on that trip he later reverses as a mistake.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not. The claim is about a spirit, so it cannot be checked directly.

mentions.claim_text: He plays the president saying sanctions will be taken off because they do not want to sanction friends, and praising the secretary of state.
mentions.quote: I can tell you we're going to be taking the sanctions off
mentions.falsify_match: Sanctions are formally lifted.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them the Turkish leader would beat the war drums and help close off the Black Sea in the days ahead, and that he saw Putin striking Warsaw.
mentions.quote: he'll help close off the Black Sea in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: The Black Sea strait is closed to shipping.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a clip of a two-state solution being urged at a summit and says this is what he told them was coming, that they are going to push for a two-state solution.
mentions.quote: I said they're going to push for a two-state solution
mentions.falsify_match: A two-state framework is formally agreed.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not. Two-state advocacy at such summits is the standing position, not a departure.

mentions.claim_text: He plays the president calling Turkey a fantastic ally and a NATO country, and saying no president has done as much for Israel.
mentions.quote: Turkey's been fantastic and a fantastic ally
mentions.falsify_match: The alliance holds.
mentions.falsify_miss: Turkey turns, which is what he claims will happen.

mentions.claim_text: He moves on from a topic he calls redundant to another church item.
mentions.quote: It's kind of redundant, baby. Let's move on
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a transition.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He wonders whether a report of new discoveries is the thing he saw and whether the earthquake comes next, then notes a major bust of smugglers which he says they had been praying specifically about.
mentions.quote: Will the earthquake come next?
mentions.falsify_match: An earthquake follows the discovery he is pointing at.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He puts it as a question rather than a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He prays angels camped around them, the blood of Jesus over them, and every plot and plan across the land brought to nothing from sea to sea.
mentions.quote: the angels of the Lord are camped around and about them
mentions.falsify_match: No major attack occurs on American soil.

mentions.claim_text: He says a distraction is coming with the emergency number, that what was in New York with the computers and the SIM cards is now in another area, and that mobile devices are attached to disrupt cell networks, naming Chicago.
mentions.quote: There's coming a distraction with 911
mentions.falsify_match: A SIM based attack disrupts emergency calling in another city.

mentions.claim_text: He describes twelve million people grieving their president at a funeral and throwing things at the American president, and says a hedge of protection must be prayed because he will be in Turkey on their turf.
mentions.quote: He's going to be in Turkey on their turf
mentions.falsify_match: An incident against the president during the Turkish visit.

mentions.claim_text: He says a strike is coming against Damascus in the days ahead, that he saw them beating war drums and going to a wounded brother alongside Russia because of an escalation of war.
mentions.quote: a strike coming against Damascus in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: A major strike on Damascus.

mentions.claim_text: He says he asked whether the missile was nuclear and was told it is not nuclear but a new type of weapon never used before, and that the Lord said to watch Poland and Warsaw for an escalation.
mentions.quote: this is not nuclear, but it is a weapon that has never been used
mentions.falsify_match: A novel weapon type is used near Warsaw.

mentions.claim_text: Pointing at headlines about Russia planning an attack on Poland, he says that when they strike Warsaw with a weapon never seen before there will be an American draft, which he saw behind the scenes.
mentions.quote: when they strike Warsaw with a weapon that we've never seen before
mentions.falsify_match: A Warsaw strike followed by American conscription.

mentions.claim_text: He says the headline is about the same place he was shown over a year ago, that they see in part, that he often has no idea of timing, and that this is why the prophetic is hard for him.
mentions.quote: we don't know what time. A lot of times I don't have a clue
mentions.falsify_match: He continues to state timing uncertainty rather than asserting dates.
mentions.falsify_miss: He asserts timing he does not have.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a chamber where something was held in massive chains, an angel releasing a horned demonic figure out of the ground that spun around and went straight to Russia, with the words war war and a darkness coming on him.
mentions.quote: an angel release this demonic looking thing with horns
mentions.falsify_match: A general war originating from Russia.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such war. The claim is about a released spirit, so it cannot be checked directly.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him to watch Warsaw, that he is not afraid, and that Jesus is bringing forth his key faces right now.
mentions.quote: The Lord said, Watch Warsaw
mentions.falsify_match: A major event at Warsaw.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a figure being used as a poster boy and as a new Charlie Kirk for the radical side, with Harris breaking away to rebrand herself and trying to attach to the New York mayor as the coming thing.
mentions.quote: they wanted to use him as a new Charlie Kirk for the radical
mentions.falsify_match: A figure of that kind becomes prominent on the left while Harris repositions.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is people who turned their back rather than God, and prays for the president's covering and for Cuba.
mentions.quote: It's us that turned our back on him
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a theological statement.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He calls for prayer against ungodly alliances and covenants, saying agreements will be seen in the days ahead and that Turkey and Syria are trying to snare him in one.
mentions.quote: Turkey, Syria trying to snare him
mentions.falsify_match: An American agreement with Turkey and Syria that turns against American interests.

mentions.claim_text: He says Turkey does not like Iran and wants its own group, bringing in Turkey, Syria, Jordan and Egypt, and sees parts of Afghanistan with one half like the wild west.
mentions.quote: they're trying to bring Jordan in Turkey, Syria, Jordan, and Egypt
mentions.falsify_match: A regional bloc forms of those four states.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is about Ezekiel 38 and 39 and the hook in the jaw, and that he sees a divided Ukraine split at Kyiv.
mentions.quote: This is about Ezekiel 38 and 39. I see the hook in the jaw
mentions.falsify_match: Ukraine is partitioned at Kyiv.

mentions.claim_text: He says they want to divide Ukraine, that he wants to break a peace agreement with Turkey behind it, and calls for watching the meetings ahead.
mentions.quote: He wants to break a peace agreement and Turkey want to be behind it
mentions.falsify_match: A peace agreement collapses with Turkish involvement.

mentions.claim_text: He prays protection over the president that is not just physical but against being deceived, saying it is a spirit and that without a prayer covering he does not realise the pull.
mentions.quote: It's not just physical protection, but being deceived
mentions.falsify_match: The president makes an agreement he later abandons as a mistake.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a demonic spirit like a vampire on the man of Turkey, present around Syria and tied to an Islamic brotherhood, and notes the Saudi crown prince has been silent.
mentions.quote: it's a demonic spirit like a vampire on the man of Turkey
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey turns openly against Israel and the West.

mentions.claim_text: He asks repeatedly what will be done with Gaza, and says they present plans to build a golf course and storefronts and make it great again.
mentions.quote: We're going to build a golf course. We want to build storefronts
mentions.falsify_match: Commercial redevelopment plans for Gaza are published.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees the lobbying against the Clarity Act and against the Save America Act.
mentions.quote: I see the lobbying against the Clarity Act
mentions.falsify_match: Lobbying against both bills is documented.

mentions.claim_text: He says JP Morgan is raising a fuss, that it is the banks lobbying and they are losing their stronghold, and that the Save America Act has a pretty big heel.
mentions.quote: It's the lobbying with the banks, but they're losing their stronghold
mentions.falsify_match: Bank opposition to the bills fails.

mentions.claim_text: He sees a shaking on the Mississippi at 4.5, says explicitly that it will not be a great one and that it is a warning.
mentions.quote: a shaking on the Mississippi, but it will not be a great one
mentions.falsify_match: A magnitude 4 range New Madrid event.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such event. Magnitude 4 quakes occur on that system every year or two, so this is a low bar he sets deliberately low.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them they will invade Havana in the middle of the night when it is dark using a cyber attack, and that Cuba will be liberated in a cyber attack against their power grid.
mentions.quote: they will invade Havana in the middle of the night when it's dark
mentions.falsify_match: An American operation against Havana beginning with a grid cyber attack.

mentions.claim_text: He prays cover over troops and civilians, that it will be quick, that prosperity will come on Cuba and that the dictators will be removed.
mentions.quote: prosperity will come on Cuba and the dictators will be removed
mentions.falsify_match: The Cuban government falls and the economy opens.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will believe every plot and plan to kill, steal and destroy is brought to nothing and that they will uncover what the enemy planned for that day, from the Gulf to Canada.
mentions.quote: his plans to try to do today from the Gulf all the way to Canada
mentions.falsify_match: A plot is uncovered on the Fourth of July.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him to pray over Israel because he saw a major attack again by drones, using weapons they are not used to rather than the usual rockets.
mentions.quote: I saw a major attack again by drones
mentions.falsify_match: A large drone attack on Israel using an unfamiliar weapon type.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the Iranian leader's funeral held on the third with anger at America, and says he saw retaliation coming into America which he called an act of war though it will be called terrorism.
mentions.quote: I said this is an act of war what I saw coming into America
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on American soil traced to Iranian direction.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told them to pray for New Orleans and that he saw an attack on Bourbon Street.
mentions.quote: I saw an attack on Bourbon Street
mentions.falsify_match: A further attack on Bourbon Street.
mentions.falsify_miss: No further attack. The 1 January 2025 attack there is already behind this, which he treated as a failure of intercession.

mentions.claim_text: He says corruption in Atlanta will affect the Senate race in the days ahead, notes the FBI being sent to look at Atlanta and Georgia, and says he heard the devil went down to Georgia.
mentions.quote: I heard the devil went down to Georgia
mentions.falsify_match: Election fraud findings in Georgia affecting the Senate race.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over Senate seats not to turn blue, corrects himself that one is already blue and should go red, and says the president has something inside him driving it.
mentions.quote: praying over seats in the Senate to not turn blue
mentions.falsify_match: Republicans hold or gain those Senate seats.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord said they will lose control, and that he saw straight line winds over one hundred and fifty miles an hour like category four hurricane winds, as they try to control the weather.
mentions.quote: as they try to control the weather they will lose control
mentions.falsify_match: A derecho with sustained winds above 150 mph.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such event. The strongest recorded derecho winds are around 140 mph, so this exceeds the observed maximum.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts Gideon's three hundred blowing horns on the hill so that the enemy turned on themselves, and says that is what is going to happen, with a turnaround coming.
mentions.quote: they blew their horns and they all turned on themselves
mentions.falsify_match: Opponents of the administration turn on each other publicly.

mentions.claim_text: Noting an investigation opened into the California governor, he repeats that in the days ahead he will be seen getting on his belly like a snake and slithering, licking the dirt, to go to the White House.
mentions.quote: you will see Gavin Newsom get on his belly like a snake
mentions.falsify_match: Newsom mounts a national campaign in a humiliating posture.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not run, or runs from strength.

mentions.claim_text: He sees the fox looking to New Orleans and says Cuba will line up with Iran, with no more air raids because it is for drones.
mentions.quote: Cuba will line up with Iran and no more air raids
mentions.falsify_match: A formal Cuba and Iran military alignment.

mentions.claim_text: He says they want to cause a rift and bring a civil war up north in New York with rioting, and that he sees fires in the buildings in New York, naming a funder.
mentions.quote: They want to bring a civil war up north, New York
mentions.falsify_match: Organised rioting and building fires in New York.

mentions.claim_text: Speaking largely in tongues, he calls a multitude coming to the church in Canada with fresh fire in the lips, from coast to coast.
mentions.quote: The multi will come. A fresh fire in the lips
mentions.falsify_match: A Canadian revival movement with mass attendance.

mentions.claim_text: He calls a shaking over Canada, over the prime minister and over Toronto, and says he sees a ground zero over Toronto with the American flag floating over it.
mentions.quote: I see a shaking over Carney. I see a shaking over Toronto
mentions.falsify_match: A major event in Toronto and political upheaval for the prime minister.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a dark black glove hanging over Toronto that will lose its grip in certain areas but not completely, holding on tight because there is a pyramid there.
mentions.quote: it will lose its grip in certain areas
mentions.falsify_match: A partial religious revival in Toronto.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The partial framing means neither a revival nor its absence fully settles it.

mentions.claim_text: He says the glory will spring forth like a mighty well, a gusher and a geyser, over South Korea and over Taiwan.
mentions.quote: It will be so glorious over South Korea
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised revival in South Korea and Taiwan.

mentions.claim_text: On the nation's two hundred and fiftieth anniversary he asks that the president be given a second wind, says God has not forgotten America, that he feels a humbling coming, and that the church will arise and shine in the middle of what he sees.
mentions.quote: on this 250th anniversary of our beautiful nation
mentions.falsify_match: A national humbling followed by a church resurgence.
